name: context
description: Call this FIRST in every mind map run, and again if you lose track. Returns your brief and goal, run mode (apply = writes go live; propose = writes become a proposal a human reviews), template and lens, your node with its ancestors and an id-tagged outline of its subtree, budget left (nodes, sub-agents, depth), your open ask_human questions with any answers, and nodes other agents have claimed nearby. Read-only.

subtree_depth.description: Levels of your subtree to include. Default 2.
